title: Star Wars: The Death Star Rescue
description: A short stormtrooper, two secret numbers, and a garbage masher—A New Hope's deepest in-jokes in five steps.

questions.question: Disguised as stormtroopers—one of them "a little short"—Luke and Han storm the Death Star to rescue which princess?
questions.explanation: Her first words to her rescuer: "Aren't you a little short for a stormtrooper?" Carrie Fisher was 19 during filming, and later became one of Hollywood's go-to script doctors.

questions.question: On the way to Leia, Luke bluffs that Chewbacca is a "prisoner transfer from cell block" what number—a nod to Lucas's first feature film?
questions.explanation: THX 1138 (1971) flopped, so almost nobody caught it in 1977. Lucas has hidden 1138 in the saga ever since—on monitors, battle droids, even Boushh's helmet in Return of the Jedi.
questions.hint: His first film was called THX ____

questions.question: After the cell block 1138 bluff, Han learns Leia is held in cell what number—a tribute to an experimental short that inspired Lucas?
questions.explanation: Arthur Lipsett's 1963 collage film 21-87 obsessed young Lucas; some trace the idea of "the Force" to a line in it. Leia's cell sits in Detention Block AA-23.

questions.question: Blasting out of cell 2187, everyone dives down a garbage chute into a trash compactor—home to what one-eyed, tentacled creature?
questions.explanation: "I purposely made myself red-faced for a strangulated look," Hamill admitted, and burst a blood vessel in his eye. Lucas told him the red lighting made it pointless.
questions.hint: The film never says its name; it just grabs Luke and drags him under

questions.question: Free of the dianoga's grip, Han mutters a line that became a running gag across the saga. What is it?
questions.answer: I've got a bad feeling about this

questions.explanation: Luke says it first, on the Falcon ("I have a very bad feeling about this"). It has turned up in nearly every Star Wars film since. Then the walls start moving.

easterEgg.title: Leia's cell came back
easterEgg.text: Thirty-eight years later, The Force Awakens gave Finn the stormtrooper number FN-2187—the same as Leia's cell. The numbers were never random.
